title: vicia lens subsp. orientalis
intro: Vicia lens subsp. orientalis, commonly known as Persian grass pea, is a subspecies of the vetch plant, belonging to the legume family. It is a type of drought-resistant, hardy plant that has been traditionally consumed as a source of protein, particularly in areas with limited agricultural resources. The health benefits of Vicia lens subsp. orientalis include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar, and provide essential amino acids. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, saponins, and flavonoids, which are believed to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
